messages:
Sam W: Heads-up — runbook link in Deploy -> Rollback (step 3) is 404 in staging. Caught in the smoke test. Anyone own that doc? /cc @Anya P @Kate
Anya P: Which exact path? I hit the same 404: /kb/runbooks/deploy#rollback-step-3
Jordan: Looks like the anchor moved during the TOC tidy last week. I'll take it. Will open a tiny PR to restore the anchor and fix a curl snippet.
Lee: If you're editing, can you also update the curl host (old `staging-api.internal` -> `staging-api.redwood`)? That bit broke some of my local tests.
DocsBot: automated: link-scan flagged /kb/runbooks/deploy anchor missing — creating issue #4123.
Sam W: Thanks. Jordan — can you drop the PR link here once ready? Need a quick CR from eng oncall. @Mike FYI
Jordan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2387 — frontmatter tweak + anchor + curl snippet. Quick test: `yarn dev --preview` then `grep -n "rollback-step-3" -R docs/`. Marking `docs:hotfix` label.
Kate: I can take the review if Mike is tied up. Does this affect Dedicated docs or just internal runbook?
Jordan: Just internal runbook for deploys — Dedicated docs unaffected.
Lee: Also suggest adding a one-liner safety note about not using `kubectl rollout undo` blindly (we've tripped that before).
Anya P: If Jordan can't get to the PR within 2h I'll pick it up. Can we add `docs:hotfix` label so it's fast-tracked?
Jordan: Added the label and updated PR with the safety note.
Mike: I'll review in ~30m and ping back.
Sam W: After merge can we add a redirect so older links don't 404? @DocsBot any ETA on redirect deploys?
DocsBot: Redirect queued. Will deploy on next CDN sync (approx 1h after merge).
Jordan: Merged PR #2387 and closed issue #4123 — changed anchor back and updated snippet. 
DocsBot: Redirect deployed for /kb/runbooks/deploy (old slug) — live now.
Sam W: Awesome, thanks everyone. Closing the loop here.
